title: Walking with Light · as Ye Peida
description: Walking with Light was created for the 70th anniversary of Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT). I played the male lead, Ye Peida. After more than five months of rehearsals, the production took the stage at BUPT’s Shahe Grand Theatre in October 2025, then at the Central Academy of Drama in November. It received the Gold Award, Best Production and Best Actor awards at the 2025 Beijing Collegiate Drama Festival. From rehearsals to performances, the time we shared was full of passion and will always stay with me.
period: October–November 2025 · over five months of rehearsals
